notes.subject: הרמש הרמש
notes.rationale: noun + verb of the same root (remes romes, 'creeping thing that creepeth'), an inflection of the verb for emphasis; the repetition survives in 'i save wokabaut' but the root echo is lost.

notes.subject: ושרצו
notes.rationale: 'swarm/teem' rendered as 'karim planti' — the picture of swarming wriggling abundance is softened.

notes.subject: הוצא
notes.rationale: Hiphil imperative 'bring out!' rendered 'kisim i go aut', losing the direct-imperative force toward Noach.

translation: Olgeta ol samting i gat laip we i stap wantaim yu, long olgeta mit — ol pisin, na ol animal bilong lukautim, na olgeta ol binatang na ol samting i save wokabaut long graun — kisim ⟨את⟩ ol i go aut wantaim yu, bai ol i karim planti long graun, na ol i kirap olgeta, na ol i kam planti long graun.
